criterion_note: Three-way comparison of the reference onboard results, the Windows recomputation and the Linux rerun, 75 values per method per pair = 5 seeds x 3 doses x 5 metrics (psnr, ssim, cnr_mean, cho_auc_mean, npwe_mean). 'differ' = absolute difference above the shipped pre-registered criterion 1e-6 (unchanged). n is checked separately and not part of the 75-value grid.

windows.name: Windows recomputation (byte-level snapshot of the reference source, same Windows stack)

sets.hash_convention: SHA-256 over the bytes git stores for each listed file (git cat-file blob HEAD:<repo-relative path>, i.e. the LF bytes of a checkout with core.autocrlf=false), not over Windows CRLF working copies. Files not tracked at HEAD fall back to a binary read of the working copy; each entry's convention is recorded in hash_sources. Fixes the earlier three-way hashes taken over CRLF working copies, which matched none of the committed bytes.

Moves "a different build or kernel path in the reference stack" from consistent-with toward shown; rules out data or weights as the source. See HEYANG_REPLY_2026-09-26.md 1.4.
